trading_day_rules.ose_night_session: Trading day runs from night-session start through the following business-day day session. Night trades are treated on the following trading-day basis.
trading_day_rules.holiday_trading: Holiday-trading dates require JPX holiday-trading calendar treatment and cannot be inferred from ordinary weekday rules alone.

hard_rules: Never apply the latest 2026 session hours to historical observations.
A source-provided date label must be reconciled with the venue's trading-day convention before aggregation.
Session-version correction is a data-integrity change, not a tunable model parameter.
Any historical high-frequency result produced with the wrong session version must be retained for audit and rerun as a labeled DI correction.
Pre-2011 OSE derivatives had a midday recess; do not aggregate 11:00-12:30 JST as an active futures session.
